welcomeMessage: Welcome to your digital clinic. Here you will find all the tools to manage your practice efficiently.
settingsTipDetail: You can change the language and theme (light/dark) at any time from the Settings section.
crudIntro: From the different sections, you can create, view, edit, and delete records for:
crudNote: Some modules require prior data (for example: an appointment requires a registered owner and pet).
pricingDescription: Manage your subscription plans, payment methods, and account status.
billingDescription: Register invoices, track payments received, and generate receipts for your clients.
reportsDescription: View important statistics: sales, patients seen, appointments completed, inventory, and more.
auditDescription: Review the history of actions and changes made in the system for better control and security.
getStarted: Get started by exploring the menu sections!
